Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Here is a proposal for you to review.

For 10 people, 4 hours per day, over two days, the package is the Studio (it holds up to 12 people) with one coffee break for every attendee:



| Item | Detail | Price |
|---|---|---:|
| Studio (V1) | 4 hours | €240 |
| Coffee break (S1) | 10 people x €8 | €80 |
| **Total for ONE booking** (of 2 requested) | | **€320** |
| Budget | | €700 |
| Difference | | not comparable: the total covers one booking only |



Please note that the prices above cover ONE booking (one day) only. Your request involves two separate bookings, so the second day still has to be priced. The table should not be read as the price of the whole two days.

Assumptions:
- You didn't mention accessibility, so we have assumed nobody needs wheelchair access. The Studio can only be reached by stairs. If anyone needs a route without stairs, please tell us. The Loft is wheelchair accessible and holds up to 24 people.
- Bookings come in 4-hour blocks, which matches what you asked for.

Dates: we have to check availability separately for your two consecutive days. This draft does not hold anything for you.

Please get in touch if you'd like to adjust anything.

Kind regards

reasons: All stated requirements are met, subject to the listed assumptions.

Accessibility not stated: assumed no wheelchair access is needed. The Studio is stairs-only.
flags: Date/urgency request (two consecutive days): dates need a separate availability check. Nothing can be confirmed or booked from this draft.

standing_notes: Only 4-hour bookings exist; there is no longer-duration price.

No discounts of any kind are available.
